description: Manufacturer PiPER arm collision hulls and joint origins, independently extracted from installed public URDF/STL geometry; no robot-control implementation copied.
units: millimetres; joint origin rotation matrices; joint axes unit vectors
limitations: Arm links1..6 only; excludes base mount, gripper (separate vendor_gripper_hull.json), cameras, brackets, cables and surroundings. Convex hull support exact for plane clearance of original meshes; calibrated mounting is not established.
